'''Popafam''' is a [[Rock]] type [[Tank]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves from [[Popagrind]] at 36 stars after completing their specific [[trials|evolution trials]].

==Overview==
Current Description: "Before, hitting a dead end meant giving up. But now, Popafam knows to carry on no matter how many obstacles need to be faced. With time, comes true understanding of your responsibility."

Popafam is a rainbow rarity Tatari.

== Trivia ==
* Popafam and its evolutions were added to the game on 10/72026 alongside [[Cactobodhi]] and [[Armavolve]].
